settings.about_title: Kampala Junior Academy, Growing with You Since 1993.
settings.about_body: Kampala Junior Academy (KJA) is one of the leading private schools in Uganda, offering nursery school, daycare, and primary school education since 1993. The school was founded by Mrs Mary Mulumba, a dedicated teacher with over 60 years in the field of early childhood education. From the beginning, her dream was clear — to give young learners a strong start in life through quality, caring, holistic and child friendly education.
settings.vision: To be an inclusive school that has high aspirations for every child, to create a well facilitated institution that is capable of shaping children into future responsible leaders.
settings.mission: To give learners the best possible head start on their academic careers by encouraging their natural inquisitiveness, creativity and motivation to learn.
settings.campuses_intro: We started humbly, with only a Nursery Section at Clement Hill Road, focusing on the youngest children in our care. Our daycare and preschool programs helped parents feel supported, knowing their little ones were in safe hands. By 1997, we had grown to open our Primary section, and in 2003, we proudly saw our first P7 pupils sit for their Primary Leaving Exams (PLE). Today, Kampala Junior Academy has five campuses across Kampala.

pages.body:
Welcome to the thriving and inspiring world of careers at Kampala Junior School, where dedication and passion come together to nurture the next generation of leaders. Our committed team of educators at both nursery school and primary school levels creates a dynamic learning environment that sparks curiosity and a lifelong love of learning.

At Kampala Junior School, we believe in the transformative power of early childhood education and primary learning within an inclusive and supportive community. We prioritize hiring educators who bring not only outstanding teaching skills but also creativity and innovation to the classroom. We understand that quality education goes beyond textbooks, and we encourage our staff to infuse their unique talents and ideas, enabling students to explore, question, and discover with enthusiasm.

Diversity is at the heart of our school culture, and we seek educators who contribute to the rich mosaic of experiences that make Kampala Junior School a truly special place for learners.

Becoming part of our team means joining a collaborative and supportive family dedicated to professional growth. Whether you are an experienced teacher or a recent graduate passionate about making a difference, Kampala Junior School offers a platform to inspire young minds and impact Uganda’s educational future.

We invest deeply in our educators’ development through regular workshops, seminars, and mentorship programs, ensuring they stay current with the latest teaching methods and educational technology. This commitment to ongoing training helps our teachers thrive and maintain the high standards that define our school.

If you’re ready to build a rewarding career in our daycare, nursery school or primary school, please send your CV and supporting documents to info@kja.ug.

pages.body:
At the heart of every child’s educational journey lies the vital decision of choosing the right school. At Kampala Junior Academy, we recognize how important it is for families to find an institution that reflects their values, supports holistic development, and provides a nurturing, inspiring environment.

We warmly invite you to visit any of our campuses and discover what makes our approach to early childhood education truly exceptional:
➢ Bunga – Nursery School.

➢ Makindye – Nursery School.

➢ Kitante – Nursery School & Primary School.

➢ Najjanankumbi – Nursery School & Primary School.

➢ Ntinda – Daycare & Nursery School.

Whether you're looking for a vibrant and caring daycare, nursery school or a strong foundation in a primary school, Kampala Junior Academy offers the perfect setting for your child’s early years. Our campuses are designed to promote curiosity, confidence, and creativity — all essential components of a well-rounded education.

By visiting, you’ll experience firsthand the warmth and excellence that define our learning spaces. Our classrooms and outdoor areas are intentionally designed to support developmentally appropriate activities that encourage exploration, problem-solving, and joyful learning — the core of early learning.

Meeting our dedicated educators is a key part of your visit.

At Kampala Junior Academy, our teachers are more than instructors — they are mentors who guide each child with compassion, knowledge, and personalized attention. They work in close partnership with families to nurture the academic, emotional, and social growth of every learner.

To help us make your visit personal and meaningful, we encourage you to visit our campuses. This ensures we can take the time to answer your questions, give you a tailored tour, and help you understand how our programs — from daycare through nursery school to primary school can support your child’s development.

Choosing the right school is a significant step toward your child’s bright future. We invite you to explore our campuses and see how Kampala Junior Academy stands out as a leader in early childhood education.

Let’s walk this exciting journey together — nurturing young minds and shaping the Future Leaders of tomorrow.

To begin your child’s enrollment, simply click here to apply online.
We can’t wait to welcome you to the KJA family!

pages.title: Young Hearts, Big Impact: Growing Leaders Through Service at KJA
pages.excerpt: At Kampala Junior Academy, leadership and service are not just ideals — they are lived values rooted in our daily practice. From the earliest stages of early childhood education through […]
pages.body:
At Kampala Junior Academy, leadership and service are not just ideals — they are lived values rooted in our daily practice. From the earliest stages of early childhood education through to primary school, we instill in our learners a deep understanding that true leadership is grounded in service to others. Through structured leadership opportunities and a nurturing environment, we empower students to become responsible, visionary individuals ready to lead with compassion and integrity.

School Prefects: Fostering Responsibility and Accountability

Our prefect system is an integral part of student life. Through democratic elections, primary school learners are given the chance to take on leadership roles that promote responsibility and self-discipline. Prefects are chosen by both peers and teachers, and they serve as role models who exemplify our values of accountability, service, and excellence. These roles cultivate leadership qualities from an early age, aligning with our mission to nurture future leaders.

Club Leaders: Nurturing Passionate Visionaries.

Our vibrant co-curricular environment includes a variety of student-led clubs, from science and literature to sports and the performing arts. Club leaders are students who demonstrate initiative, creativity, and a passion for engaging others. These opportunities help learners develop confidence, teamwork, and communication skills — all essential for leadership and lifelong learning, especially during the critical stages of early learning and development.

Student Council: A Voice for the Student Body.

The Student Council provides a platform for students to participate in school governance and express their ideas. Elected representatives act as liaisons between students and staff, advocating for positive change and supporting initiatives that improve the school community. This experience in democratic engagement equips students with the tools to become thoughtful, active citizens — a vital part of their growth during primary school years.

Class Monitors: Building a Supportive Community.

Within the classroom, class monitors help maintain order and foster a supportive, respectful environment. These student leaders take on responsibilities such as organizing class activities and communicating with teachers, gaining skills in organization, empathy, and collaboration. It’s another important step in the journey of leadership that begins during early learning and continues throughout their academic path.

At Kampala Junior Academy, our motto "For Future Leaders" is more than words. It is a promise. Through our emphasis on leadership roles at every stage of development, from early childhood education to the upper levels of primary school, we are preparing students to be leaders who understand that service, humility, and responsibility are the foundation of real change. In doing so, we ensure that our graduates are not only academically accomplished but also empowered to make a lasting impact in their communities and beyond.

To begin your child’s enrollment, simply click here to apply online.

pages.title: Strong Bodies, Bright Minds: Sports at Kampala Junior Academy
pages.excerpt: In the ever-evolving world of education, Kampala Junior Academy shines as a beacon of holistic growth, deeply rooted in a commitment to early childhood education and beyond. We understand that […]
pages.body:
In the ever-evolving world of education, Kampala Junior Academy shines as a beacon of holistic growth, deeply rooted in a commitment to early childhood education and beyond. We understand that a truly well-rounded child doesn’t only learn in the classroom — they also grow through sports and extracurricular activities that build character, teamwork, and resilience.

From our nursery school to our primary school students, we emphasize that sports are more than just games; they’re powerful tools for developing confidence, discipline, and leadership. Our wide range of programs and clubs ensures every learner finds a space to thrive — academically, physically, and socially.

Swimming: Dive into Excellence

Our swimming program is open to students across all levels, including daycare, preschool, and primary school, helping them gain water confidence, learn proper techniques, and even train for national school competitions. Taught by certified coaches, it builds lifelong skills in water safety and fitness, promoting both physical and mental strength from an early age.

Football: The Beautiful Game, The Beautiful Journey.

Through our partnership with Talent Xtra Sports Club, fully registered under FUFA Youth Football, our football program helps learners in nursery school, preschool, and primary school build both technical football skills and important life values. Through friendly games and tournaments, children develop collaboration, leadership, and sportsmanship — while having fun doing it.

Athletics: Run, Jump, Soar.

Our athletics program nurtures champions from the ground up. Students, including those in primary school, participate in track and field events that push them to explore their personal strengths and develop physical stamina and mental resilience. Whether it’s running, jumping, or throwing, athletics becomes a journey of self-belief and perseverance.

Net Games: Aces and Volleys.

At Kampala Junior Academy, net games like badminton are introduced to children from an early age. Certified coaches guide students in building hand-eye coordination, strategy, and fair play. This fun and active sport promotes quick thinking and healthy competition among learners of all levels.

In all of these activities, we strive to ensure that sports and extracurricular life are integrated into our philosophy of early childhood education. Whether in a classroom or on the field, nursery school to primary school, we create an environment where every child’s potential is nurtured and celebrated.

pages.title: Voices, Rhythm, and Grace: Shaping Confident Learners Through Performing Arts
pages.excerpt: At Kampala Junior Academy, we believe education is more than just books — it’s about nurturing the whole child from early childhood education through primary school. We understand how important […]
pages.body:
At Kampala Junior Academy, we believe education is more than just books — it’s about nurturing the whole child from early childhood education through primary school. We understand how important creativity and cultural awareness are in shaping young minds, and that’s why our preschool and primary programs shine as places where the arts and culture come alive.

Celebrating the Arts.

We know that the arts are a powerful way for children in early childhood education and beyond to express themselves, discover who they are, and grow emotionally. Our performing arts program gives every student—from nursery school through primary school—the chance to explore their creative side — whether it’s through music, drama, dance, or visual arts. We celebrate all kinds of artistic expression and encourage every child to find their own special voice.

Music: Finding Your Own Beat

In our music studios, students learn to play different instruments and appreciate the beauty of harmonies. From traditional songs to modern beats, our music lessons cover many styles so every child—from daycare, preschool, to primary school—can connect with sound and rhythm. With passionate teachers and group performances, students build not only musical talent but also teamwork and friendship.

Drama: Telling Stories and Building Confidence.

The stage is a place where stories come alive and confidence grows. Our MDD program helps students from early childhood education through primary school bring stories to life through acting, improvisation, and plays. Beyond performing, drama teaches children to communicate well, understand others, and be brave in sharing their ideas.

Dance: Moving with Culture and Joy.

Dance is a language everyone understands. Our dance program takes students on a journey through different styles—from traditional African dances to ballet and contemporary moves. Dance keeps children active while helping them appreciate the beauty of different cultures and traditions across all levels, including nursery school and primary levels.

Visual Arts: Bringing Imagination to Life.

In our art rooms, children from preschool to primary school explore painting, drawing, sculpture, and even digital design. They learn to see the world with fresh eyes and turn their ideas into real works of art. Creating art boosts their confidence and pride, as they express feelings and stories through colours and shapes.

Dance: Moving with Culture and Joy.

Dance is a language everyone understands. Our dance program takes students on a journey through different styles—from traditional African dances to ballet and contemporary moves. Dance keeps children active while helping them appreciate the beauty of different cultures and traditions across all levels, including nursery school and primary levels.

Visual Arts: Bringing Imagination to Life.

In our art rooms, children from preschool to primary school explore painting, drawing, sculpture, and even digital design. They learn to see the world with fresh eyes and turn their ideas into real works of art. Creating art boosts their confidence and pride, as they express feelings and stories through colours and shapes.

Embracing Culture Together.

At Kampala Junior Academy, cultural understanding is part of everyday learning across all levels—from daycare and nursery school to primary school. Our curriculum includes cultural studies that open students’ eyes to the rich diversity of the world around them. Through cultural events, festivals, and exchange programs, students learn to respect and celebrate differences, building unity and harmony.

In short, Kampala Junior Academy is more than just a school — it’s a place where children grow fully, academically and creatively, through every stage of early childhood education to primary school. By focusing on the performing arts and culture, we prepare our students not only to succeed in school but also to shine as confident, creative, and culturally aware individuals ready to thrive in a connected world.

Our commitment to a well-rounded education means every child leaves us—from daycare, nursery school all the way to primary school—with the knowledge, skills, and character to face the future with courage and joy.

pages.title: Learning for Life: Building Strong Foundations
pages.excerpt: Kampala Junior Academy shines as a beacon of academic excellence, providing abundant learning opportunities across all levels—from daycare, nursery school to primary school. Our commitment to offering a complete, holistic […]
pages.body:
Kampala Junior Academy shines as a beacon of academic excellence, providing abundant learning opportunities across all levels—from daycare, nursery school to primary school. Our commitment to offering a complete, holistic education aligns with the Ministry of Education and Sports' teaching and examination guidelines, as well as the National Curriculum Development Center-approved curriculum. We provide a nurturing environment where learners in early childhood education and beyond not only achieve academic success but also develop a strong passion for learning through a broad range of subjects.

Science: Exploring the Wonders Around Us

Our science curriculum sparks curiosity and inquiry at every stage, encouraging students—from nursery through primary school—to explore the wonders of the natural world. Classrooms become laboratories of discovery where hands-on experiments, research projects, and interactive lessons empower students to apply knowledge to real-world scenarios, promoting critical thinking and scientific literacy.

Mathematics: Growing Our Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills

In mathematics, we build a strong foundation in logical reasoning and problem-solving for learners across early childhood education up to primary school. Our curriculum, guided by national standards, covers essential topics like sets, graphs, measurements, and geometry. Engaging lessons and collaborative challenges help students master mathematical concepts that prepare them for future academic and professional success.

Social Studies: Discovering Our Roots and Community

At Kampala Junior Academy, Social Studies classes offer immersive experiences that deepen students’ understanding of cultures, history, and society. Our curriculum encourages learners in preschool and primary school to develop empathy, cultural awareness, and civic responsibility through the study of history, civics, and environmental conservation.

Religious Education: Nurturing Values and Good Values

Our religious education program fosters respect for diversity and freedom of belief, nurturing students’ understanding of various faiths. It supports learners in early childhood education and beyond to appreciate cultural and ethical dimensions of different religions, promoting tolerance and respect within our school community.

English Literacy & Comprehension: Mastering the Art of Communication

English literacy is a cornerstone of effective communication and critical thinking across all KJA levels. From nursery school to primary school, students engage with a rich variety of texts—from classic literature to modern works—enhancing their reading, writing, and oral skills in an encouraging environment.

Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

Our ICT program introduces digital literacy early, supporting students through primary school. Children learn essential computer skills, use educational software, and develop problem-solving abilities that prepare them for a technology-driven future, empowering their digital knowledge from an early age.

Other Languages: Opening Doors to New Cultures and Voices

In our commitment to global awareness, we offer language programs including French, Kiswahili, and Chinese. Students across preschool and primary school enjoy these opportunities to embrace linguistic diversity, opening doors to international communication and cultural exchange.

Alongside academics, KJA offers vibrant co-curricular clubs in French, computers, arts and crafts, and more to enrich early childhood education and primary learning experiences.

At the heart of our success are our certified, experienced, and compassionate teachers dedicated to nurturing the whole child. Our educators serve not only as instructors but also as mentors who inspire a lifelong love of learning from nursery school through primary school.

In conclusion, Kampala Junior Academy is more than just an educational institution. It is a dynamic hub of academic exploration and holistic learning. By strictly adhering to national guidelines and approved curricula, we ensure students receive a well-rounded education that prepares them for the challenges of today’s world. Through diverse subjects and supportive teaching, we empower our learners in early childhood education and beyond to excel academically, develop valuable life skills, and embrace curiosity for a rapidly changing global landscape.

To begin your child’s enrollment, simply click here to apply online.

We can’t wait to welcome you to the KJA family!

pages.body:
At Kampala Junior Academy, we believe that every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. That’s why we proudly follow an open admissions policy — inviting learners from all backgrounds to join our school community at any point in the academic year.

We offer a complete educational journey through both our Nursery and Primary School sections, supporting children from ages 3 to 13. Whether your child is just starting in preschool, or joining our primary school, we are committed to making the admissions process simple, accessible, and inclusive.

🎓 When to Apply:

While we accept applications all year round, our main nursery school enrollment and primary school admissions window runs from October to January. Families are especially encouraged to apply during this time for a smoother placement process — especially for children joining Nursery or Primary.

🎓 Age & Grade Placement:

We take a thoughtful approach to placing children in the right grade. Age, previous school experience, and academic readiness are all considered to ensure learners are supported and challenged appropriately.

For new pupils, we may request:

✹ Previous school transcripts.

✹ A short assessment or placement test (Primary).

This ensures your child is placed in a grade level that matches their abilities and gives them the best chance to succeed.

🎓 How to Apply:

Families have two options:

➢ Online application form.

A quick and convenient way to express interest in the nursery school or primary school enrollment.
Click here to apply online

➢ In-person.

Visit one of our campuses for a more personalized experience

Please note: Completion of the admission process requires a visit to the school. We value the chance to meet you and your child, and for you to see firsthand the welcoming and dynamic learning environment we’ve built at KJA.

🎓 Why Visit Us?

During your visit, you’ll:

✹ Meet our friendly and experienced teachers.

✹ Tour our learning spaces, playgrounds, and classrooms.

✹ Discover how our focus on early childhood education supports confident, happy learners.

At Kampala Junior Academy, our open admissions policy is more than just flexibility — it’s a commitment to diversity, accessibility, and giving each child a strong educational foundation from nursery school to primary school.

We recognize that every child is unique, and we are here to walk with you every step of the way — from the first day of preschool to the final Primary Seven exam.

🎓Enroll today and let your child thrive with us!

To begin your child’s enrollment, simply click here to apply online.

pages.body:
Kampala Junior Academy (KJA) is one of the leading private schools in Uganda, offering nursery school, daycare, and primary school education since 1993.

The school was founded by Mrs Mary Mulumba, a dedicated teacher with over 60 years in the field of early childhood education. From the beginning, her dream was clear — to give young learners a strong start in life through quality, caring, holistic and child friendly education.

Vision

To be an inclusive school that has high aspirations for every child, to create a well facilitated institution that is capable of shaping children into future responsible leaders.

Mission

To give learners the best possible head start on their academic careers by encouraging their natural inquisitiveness, creativity and motivation to learn.

We started humbly, with only a Nursery Section at Clement Hill Road, focusing on the youngest children in our care. Our daycare and preschool programs helped parents feel supported, knowing their little ones were in safe hands. By 1997, we had grown to open our Primary section, and in 2003, we proudly saw our first P7 pupils sit for their Primary Leaving Exams (PLE).

Today, Kampala Junior Academy has five campuses across Kampala:

  • Kitante
  • Bunga
  • Makindye
  • Najjanankumbi
  • Ntinda.

Each one provides a safe, nurturing space for learners at every stage — from daycare and nursery school, all the way to primary school. We believe in giving children the tools they need to succeed academically, socially, and personally. In 2021, we moved into the digital world by launching our online learning platform—so children can keep learning from home wherever they are.

Our goal is to make quality early childhood education more accessible to families in Uganda and beyond. From our first steps in 1993 to our growth in primary education and our leap into online preschool and primary learning, KJA continues to stay committed to the success of every child.

We are proud of our journey and look forward to building more bright futures through excellent education, leaving an everlasting mark on Uganda's educational environment.

To begin your child’s enrollment, simply click here to apply online

We can’t wait to welcome you to the KJA family!

pages.title: From The Director
pages.excerpt: It is my great pleasure to welcome you to Kampala Junior Academy (KJA) — a school that has proudly provided daycare, nursery school, and primary school education to families in […]
pages.body:
It is my great pleasure to welcome you to Kampala Junior Academy (KJA) — a school that has proudly provided daycare, nursery school, and primary school education to families in Uganda since 1993.

I am honored to be part of a vibrant school community that is deeply committed to providing outstanding early childhood education for every child. At KJA, we believe that each learner is unique, with special talents, interests, and passions. Our role is to nurture those gifts by creating a warm, inclusive, and supportive learning environment.

We offer a child-centered and holistic approach to education that focuses on the whole child. Our programs are carefully designed to spark curiosity, build confidence, and inspire leadership — from our daycare and preschool learners, all the way to our primary school students.

Our Nursery and Primary School curricula provide a strong foundation in academics while also helping children grow emotionally and socially. Learners are supported to master key subjects like English, Mathematics, Science, and Social Studies — essential skills for success in school and beyond.

As children move through our school, they are introduced to a wide range of academic and co-curricular activities. These include sports, etiquette, foreign languages, art, and more — all designed to build well-rounded learners with confidence and creativity. Whether a child is in preschool or preparing for Primary Seven, we give them the tools to excel in the 21st century.

At KJA, we believe leadership begins early. That’s why our curriculum weaves leadership development into everyday learning — helping our students become confident decision-makers, team players, and future changemakers.

A strong partnership between home and school is key to a child’s success. We value your trust and are committed to working closely with you to support your child’s educational journey. Whether your child is just beginning their journey in our nursery school or daycare, or is progressing through primary school, we are here every step of the way.

Thank you for choosing Kampala Junior Academy. We are excited to welcome you into our community and to walk with you as we help your child grow, dream, and succeed. Together, we are shaping the leaders of tomorrow.

Warm regards,
Andrew Mulumba
Director, Kampala Junior Academy Schools

pages.excerpt: Who we are Suggested text: Our website address is: http://84.247.190.131. Comments Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and […]
pages.body:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: http://84.247.190.131.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor's IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

As a leading early childhood education center in Kampala, we provide a balanced and structured curriculum tailored for the early years, ensuring that every child receives the attention and support they need to thrive.
campuses.body:
Hello! I’m Brenda Momanyi, the Head Teacher at Kampala Junior Academy Bunga Nursery School, a warm and welcoming Nursery School in Bunga located conveniently along Nadduli Road, between Stabex and ORYX Petrol Stations on Ggaba Road.

Our Bunga campus offers a safe, engaging, and nurturing environment where young learners can explore, learn, and grow. As a leading early childhood education center in Kampala, we provide a balanced and structured curriculum tailored for the early years, ensuring that every child receives the attention and support they need to thrive.

Clubs & Co-Curricular Activities – Discover, Explore, Shine

At Kampala Junior Academy, we believe that education goes beyond the classroom. As we thoughtfully introduce new clubs, we are excited to currently offer swimming lessons that promote physical development, confidence, and water safety.

This is just the beginning; We’re in the process of carefully vetting and introducing more enriching activities to help our students discover their talents, build new skills, and shine in every aspect of school life.

Age Groups & Classes – Bunga Nursery Campus

We offer a range of grade levels designed to meet your child’s developmental needs:

➢Daycare (Under 3 Years):

A playful and safe environment where toddlers engage in fun activities that promote creativity and social interaction. Perfect for families seeking quality daycare in Bunga.

➢Reception Class (3–4 Years):

Introduces early literacy and numeracy through songs, stories, and hands-on play.

➢Intermediate Class (4-5 Years):

Encourages independence and problem-solving with engaging, child-centered learning activities.

➢Pre-Primary Class (5-6 Years):

Prepares children for Primary One, focusing on foundational academics and essential life skills.

Each level at KJA Bunga Nursery is designed to build confidence, curiosity, and a love for learning in every child.

School Fees – Bunga Nursery.

At Kampala Junior Academy Bunga, we offer transparent and inclusive tuition:

✹ Admission Fee: UGX 30,000.

✹ Nursery Tuition: UGX 1000,000.

(Tuition includes all scholastic materials, break tea, and lunch.)

Learning Environment & Facilities

✹ Playground.

✹ Play/Toy room.

✹ Individualized age group classrooms.

✹ Restrooms.

✹ Safe drop-off and pick-up areas.

✹ Parking space.

Campus Culture

➢ Teacher-to-student ratio.

We maintain a 1:7 teacher-to-child ratio, ensuring each child receives personalized attention and care. This small class size allows for meaningful interactions, close supervision, and tailored learning experiences.

➢ Celebrations & Special Theme Days.

We make school fun and memorable by celebrating special moments throughout the year!

▫︎ Birthday Celebrations bring joy to each child’s special day.

▫︎ Cultural Days allow children to showcase their heritage and learn about others.

▫︎ Spirit Days like Pajama Day, Color Day, and Casual Wear Day bring smiles and excitement to the school week.

➢ Weekly Morning Assemblies.

Every Friday morning, the school gathers for a lively assembly filled with music, prayer, and positive energy. These sessions:

▫︎ Highlight important weekly announcements.

▫︎ Encourage children to lead songs, prayers, or short presentations.

▫︎ Build confidence and public speaking skills in a nurturing setting.

At KJA Bunga Nursery School, our vibrant campus culture helps children feel seen, supported, and celebrated every step of the way.

➢ Safe School Environment.

Our school prioritizes the safety and well-being of every child. We have a secure sign-in and sign-out system to ensure that only authorized individuals can pick up students, providing peace of mind for parents. Our campus is also monitored by security services, ensuring a safe and protected environment throughout the day.

Admissions – Join the KJA Family

We’re excited that you’re considering Kampala Junior Academy Bunga for your child’s early education. Here’s how to join our nurturing school community:

✹ Inquiry.

Call us with any questions at +256 392 700 370 or +256 752 887 045.

✹ Application Form.

Pick up and complete an admission form from our Bunga office.

✹ Required Documents:

▫︎ Completed admission form.

▫︎ Copy of parent/guardian’s ID.

▫︎ Copy of child’s immunization card.

▫︎ Two passport-size photos.

✹ Submission.

Submit your documents at our Bunga Nursery or Kitante Main Campus.

✹ Interview/Orientation.

Depending on your child’s age, a short interview or orientation may be scheduled.

✹ Confirmation & Enrollment.

Once accepted, you'll receive confirmation and complete the enrollment process.

We look forward to welcoming your child to Kampala Junior Academy Bunga Nursery School, where every day is filled with joy, discovery, and meaningful learning.

Our Customer Service contacts:

+256 39 270 0370

+256 78 265 6358

To begin your child’s enrollment, simply click here to apply online.

We can’t wait to welcome you to the KJA Bunga family!

news.title: KJA Celebrates Excellent 2025 PLE Results
news.excerpt: At Kampala Junior Academy, we are delighted to officially share our 2025 Primary Leaving Examination (PLE) results with our parents, guardians, and the wider community. This year, 131 candidates sat […]
news.body:
At Kampala Junior Academy, we are delighted to officially share our 2025 Primary Leaving Examination (PLE) results with our parents, guardians, and the wider community.

This year, 131 candidates sat for the PLE, and we are proud to report an outstanding performance:

  • 97 pupils (74%) achieved Division I
  • 34 pupils (26%) achieved Division II
  • 0 pupils in Division III & IV

We celebrate a 100% pass rate in Division I and II, a clear testimony of the hard work, discipline, and resilience of our learners.

Strong Aggregate Performance

Our aggregate distribution reflects consistency and academic strength across the class:

  • 3 pupils scored Aggregate 4
  • 13 pupils scored Aggregate 5
  • 11 pupils scored Aggregate 6
  • 11 pupils scored Aggregate 7
  • 16 pupils scored Aggregate 8
  • 20 pupils scored Aggregate 9

The majority of our candidates scored within the strongest aggregate groups, with very few pupils in the higher aggregate ranges.

A Testament to Teamwork

These results are not by chance. They are the outcome of:

  • Dedicated and experienced teachers
  • Supportive and cooperative parents
  • A structured academic programme
  • Continuous assessment and remedial support
  • Above all, disciplined and determined pupils

As a school, we believe that excellence is built through consistency, guidance, and strong moral values. We are grateful to God for seeing our candidates through this important milestone.

Looking Ahead

We congratulate our Primary Seven class of 2025 for making the school proud. As they transition to secondary school, we are confident that they will continue to uphold the values of hard work, integrity, and leadership instilled in them at Kampala Junior Academy.

To our parents and stakeholders, thank you for trusting us with your children. Together, we continue to nurture future leaders for Uganda and beyond.

Congratulations to the Class of 2025!

alumni_stories.title: Masembe Ibrahim- Class of 2007
alumni_stories.body:
Reflecting on my time at Kampala Junior Academy, I look back with immense gratitude. The school fostered a strong sense of community, discipline, and healthy competition-particularly in Mathematics, a subject l've always been passionate about. My leadership experience as Head Boy in 2007-2008 and the successful completion of my Primary Leaving Examinations marked the beginning of an exciting educational journey. I went on to attend King's College Budo for my secondary education and later pursued a degree in Software Engineering. Upon graduation, I joined KPMG UK as a Technology Auditor and Tech Risk Consultant, working with clients across banking, automotive, and tech sectors to manage technology-related risks.

Today, I serve as a Product Owner in KPMG's innovation department, leading the development of global software solutions used across the firm. Throughout this journey, I have learned the value of continuous learning, staying true to one's passions, embracing challenges, and giving back. To current students at Kampala Junior Academy: work hard, dream big, and trust that the strong foundation you are building today will pave the way for future success.

Masembe Ibrahim,
(Class of 2007)

alumni_stories.title: Yannich Garcha- Class of 2011
alumni_stories.body:
In 2008, my educational journey began at KJA, where I consistently aimed for excellence and found myself among the top achievers. Fast forward to 2013, I graduated and went to SMACK, where I faced the unique experience of boarding school life. The new environment posed challenges, but tackling each hurdle one step at a time made all the difference.

Upon completing my O-level journey, I dared to chase my dream of becoming a pilot, all while navigating the demands of A-level studies. Balancing these commitments was not simple, yet my unwavering determination kept me going. I successfully acquired my pilot’s licenses and today, I proudly serve as a commercial pilot at Bar Aviation Uganda. My role involves not only maintaining the highest safety standards but also ensuring top-tier customer- service and safety during charter flights across our nation’s skies.

To the students of KJA, I want to convey that success in achieving your goals is born from planning, determination, and incremental progress. Challenges are not roadblocks, but stepping stones to your aspirations. As you maneuver through your academic journey, remember that by embracing difficulties and focusing on one step at a time, you will develop the resilience needed to soar to new heights. Just as my time at KJA laid the foundation for my achievements, let every experience mold you into the person you aspire to be, ready to conquer the skies of possibility.

Safe School Environment
campus_sections.body: Your child’s safety is our top priority. KJA Makindye operates a secure sign-in and sign-out system, ensuring only authorized individuals can collect students. The campus is also monitored by professional security personnel, providing a protected and peaceful space for learning and play!

campus_sections.title: Weekly Morning Assemblies.
campus_sections.body:
Every Friday morning, we come together for a lively assembly filled with music, prayer, and positive energy. These gatherings:

  • ➢ Highlight weekly announcements.
  • ➢ Encourage children to lead songs, prayers, or brief presentations.
  • ➢ Build confidence and public speaking skills in a warm, supportive environment.

campus_sections.title: Celebrations & Special Theme Days.
campus_sections.body:
At KJA Makindye, we believe school should be joyful and memorable. Throughout the year, we celebrate special moments that build community and create lasting memories:

  • ➢ Birthday Celebrations make every child feel special and celebrated.
  • ➢ Sports Days encourage teamwork, healthy competition, and physical fitness.
  • ➢ Fun Days Out offer exciting off-campus adventures that expand learning beyond the classroom.

campus_sections.title: Languages spoken (English + Chinese + Swahili or other).
campus_sections.body: At our school, we are proud to celebrate the diversity of languages spoken by both our staff and students. While English is the primary language used for teaching and communication, many of our teachers and children also speak a variety of local languages such as Luganda, Runyankore, Rukiga, Lusoga, Langi, and Acholi. Additionally, some staff members are fluent in French, Chinese and Swahili, further enriching our school community.

campus_sections.title: Student Leadership and Prefects.
campus_sections.body: We believe in nurturing leadership from a young age. Our primary section has a prefect body with posts such as Head Monitor, Head Girl, Head Boy, and class prefects. These student leaders help set a good example, assist in school duties, and represent their classmates with pride and responsibility.

campus_sections.title: The 4s Club – Celebrating Achievement.
campus_sections.body: Our reward system, the 4s Club, recognizes students who excel in academics, behavior, and participation. At the end of each term, members of the 4s Club are celebrated with a special party. It’s our way of saying, “Well done – keep shining!”.

campus_sections.title: Weekly Morning Assemblies.
campus_sections.body: Every week begins with a school-wide morning assembly full of music, prayer, and positive energy. We share important announcements, go over the weekly agenda, and give children a chance to build confidence by leading songs, prayers, or short presentations.

campus_sections.title: Celebrations and Special Days
campus_sections.body: We love to make school fun and memorable! At our Nursery and Primary levels, we celebrate children’s birthdays with joy. We also host exciting Cultural Days and Spirit Days like Jajjas Day, Academic Fair, and even “Wear Mommy or Daddy’s Clothes” Day! These fun events bring smiles, laughter, and a sense of belonging to our school family.
